pages_read.title: Cisco Expressway vulnerability exploited to breach internal networks (CVE-2026-76466)
Hackers Actively Exploit Critical ASP.NET Vulnerability to Execute Remote Code and Compromise Web Servers

updated.what: Help Net Security added as a source: CISA added CVE-2026-76466 to its KEV catalog on Friday 20 November (matches KEV dateAdded); summary, plain, exec and validation note now say so; F6 port advice reworded to Help Net's 'restrict to trusted cluster node IPs'; fix 'X15.5.20 or later'; the unrevised Cisco advisory sentence moved to impact. No published fact contradicted, so no correction file.

unchanged.note: Relays Mandiant MNDT-2026-0048: same CVE, CVSS 9.3, version 0.9.1.0, observed exploitation, no actor or victim count, no patch; adds technical mechanism detail and that the last build dates from December 2008, no new defender-relevant fact (no PoC, no victims, no attribution).

unreachable.note: Returned only a JavaScript shell ('Warn- und Informationsdienst'), no advisory text; BSI is a known blocker of automated readers, not worked around.

notes: Cisco event: validate.mjs warns source-published-partial (Cisco, SecurityWeek and Security Affairs sources have no published day); those pages were not reopened in this run, so the days were not filled in rather than guessed. Build passes.
